# Set-Up

```{r}
library(sf)
library(wk)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Load Data

```{r}
planet_grids = st_read(
  "../ARTS_planet_basemaps/data/circumpolar_global_basemap_grids_2024.geojson"
)
training_tile_grids = st_read("./data/tile_footprints.geojson") |>
  mutate(
    original_order = seq(1:n())
  )
st_crs(training_tile_grids)
st_crs(training_tile_grids) = 3857

arts = st_read(
  "../ARTS/ARTS_main_dataset/v.6.0.0/ARTS_main_dataset_v.6.0.0.geojson"
) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(st_crs(training_tile_grids))
```

```{r}
world = rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
```

# Visualize Training Tiles

```{r}
(training_tile_map = ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_sf(
    data = training_tile_grids,
    aes(color = original_order),
    fill = "transparent",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis() +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-180, 180),
    ylim = c(55, 80),
    expand = FALSE
  ))
```

# Create a Coarse "Regional" Grid

```{r}
n = 22
regions = st_make_grid(
  arts,
  n = c(n, 1)
) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  mutate(
    region = c(1:n)
  ) |>
  rename(geometry = x)
# st_filter(training_tile_grids)
```

```{r}
(map_w_grids = training_tile_map +
  geom_sf(
    data = regions,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-180, 180),
    ylim = c(55, 80),
    expand = FALSE
  ))
```

# Reorder Training Tile Grids Using a Stratified Sample by Region

```{r}
training_tile_grids = training_tile_grids |>
  st_join(regions, largest = TRUE)
```

```{r}
regional_n = training_tile_grids |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(n_tiles = n(), .by = region) |>
  arrange(n_tiles) |>
  mutate(expected_order_tiles = seq(1:n()))

regions = regions |>
  full_join(regional_n, by = "region")

n_rows = regional_n |>
  summarise(max(n_tiles)) |>
  as.numeric()

training_tile_grids_reorder = training_tile_grids |>
  slice_sample(n = n_rows, by = region) |>
  mutate(
    stratified_random_order = seq(1:n()),
    .by = region
  ) |>
  arrange(stratified_random_order) |>
  mutate(
    stratified_random_order = seq(1:n())
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_sf(
    data = training_tile_grids_reorder,
    aes(color = stratified_random_order),
    fill = "transparent",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis() +
  geom_sf(
    data = regions,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = regions,
    aes(label = expected_order_tiles), # this ranks the regions from the fewest training tiles to the most training tiles, explaining the differences in color of the last plotted points in each region
    nudge_y = 15
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-180, 180),
    ylim = c(55, 87),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtitle("Training Tiles")
```

```{r}
#   training_tile_grids_reorder,
#   "./data/tile_footprints_stratified_random_order_by_region.geojson"
# )
```

# Reorder ARTS Using a Stratified Sample by Region

```{r}
arts = arts |>
  filter(TrainClass == "Positive" & LabelType == "Polygon") |>
  st_join(regions, largest = TRUE)
```

```{r}
regional_n = arts |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(n_arts = n(), .by = region) |>
  arrange(n_arts) |>
  mutate(expected_order_arts = seq(1:n()))

regions = regions |>
  full_join(regional_n, by = "region")

n_rows = regional_n |>
  summarise(max(n_arts)) |>
  as.numeric()

arts_reorder = arts |>
  slice_sample(n = n_rows, by = region) |>
  mutate(
    stratified_random_order = seq(1:n()),
    .by = region
  ) |>
  arrange(stratified_random_order) |>
  mutate(
    stratified_random_order = seq(1:n())
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_sf(
    data = arts_reorder,
    aes(color = stratified_random_order),
    fill = "transparent",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis() +
  geom_sf(
    data = regions,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_sf_text(
    data = regions,
    aes(label = expected_order_arts), # this ranks the regions from the fewest training tiles to the most training tiles, explaining the differences in color of the last plotted points in each region
    nudge_y = 15
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-180, 180),
    ylim = c(55, 87),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtitle("ARTS v6")
```

